name: @yourorg/time-rounding
description: Single source of truth for Norr's travel/work time rounding math (issue #198) — the TypeScript twin of compute_rounded_minutes in supabase/migrations/20260920090000_travel_work_time_rounding_settings.sql. Lives inside this monorepo (npm workspace package, not a published registry package) so every app in the workspace (root app, apps/pwa, ...) imports the exact same rounding logic instead of drifting copies — same reasoning @yourorg/rbac already documents for the permission matrix.
